summary: Barings Private Credit Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a $499 million term debt securitization (CLO) on May 22, 2026. Subsidiaries issued $275M Class A (SOFR+1.45%), $65M Class B (SOFR+2.00%), $30M Class C (SOFR+2.50%) secured notes and $129M subordinated notes due 2034, redeemable after May 2027. This is a routine secured financing, not a special situation transaction.
